label: Pothole
description: Report a pothole in a City street for repair.

label: Sidewalk Repair
description: Report a damaged, uplifted, or hazardous sidewalk panel.

label: Street Resurfacing Request
description: Request that a City street be evaluated for resurfacing/repaving.

label: Graffiti Removal
description: Report graffiti on public or private property for removal; a photo speeds triage.

label: Streetlight / Traffic Signal Out
description: Report a streetlight that is out or a malfunctioning traffic signal.

label: Missed Collection
description: Report a missed trash, recycling, or organics collection; next-business-day dispatch.

label: Container Repair or Replacement
description: Report a broken, missing, or stolen trash/recycling/organics cart.

label: Bulky Item Pickup
description: Schedule a bulky item pickup (furniture, appliances); limited free pickups per year.

label: Household Hazardous Waste
description: Arrange drop-off or collection information for paint, batteries, chemicals, and e-waste.

label: Illegal Dumping
description: Report illegally dumped items or materials on public property; do not handle hazardous materials yourself.

label: Homeless Encampment / Outreach
description: Report an encampment for outreach and, where applicable, cleanup coordination.

label: Parking Enforcement
description: Report a parking violation for enforcement (blocked driveway, red curb, expired meter, etc.).

label: Abandoned Vehicle
description: Report a vehicle that appears abandoned on a public street.

label: Tree Trimming
description: Request trimming of a City-owned street tree or park tree.

label: Weed Abatement
description: Report overgrown weeds or brush on City property posing a fire or access hazard.

label: Park Facility Issue
description: Report a damaged playground, restroom, irrigation, or other park facility issue.

label: Stormwater / Drainage Issue
description: Report a clogged storm drain, flooding, or drainage problem.

label: ADA Accessibility Complaint
description: Report a missing curb ramp or other accessibility barrier in the public right-of-way.

label: STRO Violation / Code Enforcement
description: Report a suspected short-term rental (STRO) violation or a property/building code enforcement issue.

label: Dead Animal Removal
description: Report a dead animal on a public street (ESD) or private property (Animal Services).

label: Other / Uncategorized
description: Catch-all for requests that don't fit another category; routed to manual triage.
